defects.problem: Silent wrong solid. Live probe through the contract translator with all guards on (plate 60x40x10, rect pocket 10x6x4, repeat step 10+web): web 0.0005 -> 23519.988 vs closed form 23520 (5.1e-7); 0.005 -> 23519.88 (5.1e-6); 0.05 -> 23518.8 (5.1e-5); 0.1 -> 23517.6 (1.0e-4); 0.15 -> 23516.4 (1.5e-4); 0.2 and above exact. The thin wall between the cuts is removed with no error and no sentence. Same with mirror(pk,'left-right',{at}) (web 0.05: 23518.8, web 0.15: 23516.4) and repeat count 3 (web 0.15: 23272.8 vs 23280). Hand-written second pocket gives the same. Rows only measured a 1 mm web (linear-pattern__holes-x5-tight); the snap guard (row 82) tests shift of same-size cuts, not the remaining web, so it does not fire. Probe: scratch critic-patterns-mirror/probe.mjs, cases4.json, cases5.json, cases6.json.

repeatAround(pocket|hole,{angle:720|-360}) and the angle/(count-1) vs angle/count split between pocket/hole and whole solid/pad are live language defects with no guard and no refusalSentence; the shipped call still builds a solid that disagrees with FreeCAD / changes meaning silently. Labelled honestly, but not fixed or refused after a fix round.

Spheres or cylinders actually apart by 1e-4..1e-3 mm (sphere d10 step 10.0001, 10.001; cylinder step 10.0001) are refused with 'meet only along an edge or at a point', which is untrue (they are apart). Safe over-refusal with a misleading sentence. Same for r2-sens-sphere-ring-d20-n12 (0.70 mm apart).

Supported curved rows pass at up to 2.8e-4 against a 3e-4 bar (5% margin); the oracle (tessellated truck volume) cannot see a 3e-4 error, e.g. a lost lens or sliver on curved copies (curved copies are not judged by the gap or sum guards).
The shown time-budget sentence says '3 seconds' (demo limit); the product value is 600 s and no case of the suite reaches it, so the live refusal path at 600 s is demonstrated only with a 3 s limit.
